_about: A saved style that ships with the studio (registers as style-demo-ugc-phone-take). A phone-first, hands-off 'screen share' product slice with a UGC feel: show first, say little, captions carry the line, proof is only what is on screen. Start an episode with: node tools/plan/style.mjs new jobs/<date>-<name> --style demo/ugc-phone-take "<what this one is about>". The fields after 'sound' (title, format, captions, pacing, broll, cta, sound_recipe, grade, ad_use, rights) are the preset's own notes: style.mjs does not read them, the lead does.
name: ugc-phone-take

shots.move: slow push in (2.4 to 2.9); a comment card with the question the film answers drops in at frame 0 under a Replying-to line and takes a like tap; the product screen is pushed in behind it
shots.sound: phone-buzz at frame 0 as the comment card drops, impact-soft as the first caption lands, finger-tap-like on the heart, riser-short into the cut
shots.focal_point: the comment card, then the first card on the product screen
shots.example_text: How do I start a board?

shots.move: one pointer-led path: a click-through cut at the sidebar item (instant swap 3 frames after the click), then the camera follows the pointer to the New button and a glow opens on hover
shots.sound: whip on the cut, finger-tap on each tap, small-whoosh as the camera follows, toast-pop as the hover opens
shots.focal_point: the sidebar item, then the New button

shots.move: the camera settles on the board's title and holds; a ring lands on it
shots.sound: text-swish as the caption arrives, success-chime as the ring lands

shots.move: a wipe to the light stage; the offer line as the large type, then the wordmark
shots.sound: offer-sting as the offer lands, logo-sting on the wordmark

decisions.what: 9:16 master for Reels, TikTok and Shorts; 12 to 20 seconds, about 16
No voice: captions carry the line, at most seven words a line, in the caption band (82 to 93 percent of the height)
The product is the b-roll: real product captures only, and the camera never cuts away from the product
The offer line is "Try it today" unless the brand has its own; no pricing claim

must_not: numbers or result claims the screen does not show
footage of a person without a clearance record
title: UGC phone take

format.colour: BT.709 SDR, limited range, yuv420p, tagged bt709

captions.emphasis: one word or phrase per line in the brand's highlight colour, heavier weight
captions.style: dark glass pill, brand headline typeface, words arrive as they are 'spoken'; no voice needed
captions.safeArea: nothing that matters within 5% of any edge (54 px sides, 96 px top and bottom)

perScene.S02: one to two lines, naming the action
perScene.S03: one line, only what is on screen
perScene.S04: none: the offer line is the large type

pacing.cameraMove: slow push in every hold (zoom 2.4 to 2.9 on a 16:9 still in a 9:16 window); camera follows the pointer, never cuts away from the product
cutsOnScreen: hook to demo: hard cut on the whip
sidebar click to the next page: instant swap 3 frames after the click

broll.rule: none needed: the product is the b-roll. Use real product captures only; if a person clip is ever added it must be cleared first.
allowed: product capture stills or recordings the brand owns
never: clips downloaded from other people's posts
any footage of a person without a clearance record

cta.note: no pricing claim; a brand's own offer line replaces it

sound_recipe.kit: library/sounds/kit.json (a brand's own files in brands/<brand>/sounds win where present)

bed.note: listen to it before the film is approved

music.note: off for a UGC feel; if on, duck under any voice (mix.py --duck-db)

sound_recipe.voice: none: captions carry the line; add a voice-over or an owner recording if the brand wants one
sound_recipe.levelRule: with no voice, effects are measured against a stand-in level (mix.py --ref-db) and mastered to -14 LUFS, true peak at or below -1 dBTP

grade.note: one recipe per clip; graded pictures are written once and read by both the preview and the export; reset returns a clip to neutral

ad_use: fine for paid and organic use when every capture in the film is the brand's own or cleared

rights.note: An original preset made for this studio and free to use in your films. The captures and stills you put in it need their own clearance.
